items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: Little canary boy, he blew it with his wrist.

ctx.x: They had a good band. Did he use it all the time or not?

I never, I never, they used the slapstick all the time. But, so, they had a pretty good band, them fellas. Yeah, I never just got to hear them. Yeah, they had a nice band Sam Morgan. They had a nice band. They were a nice band, huh? So, yeah, them drum players, you see the drummer used to use slapsticks too. You know I tell you, most them drummers used to use all them kind of different things like them shows, you know what I mean? You see that when, long time ago when they had vaudeville on stage, drummer have…
Yeah, they don't use them much.

items.title: "Kid Thomas" Valentine Interview, 1962-11-01
items.q: Yes, that's him. The pirate. Yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah. He was living in that place.

ctx.x: Do you sure? No, no. Not the banjo player. That's your boy that made that record of him, put it out in England. The banjo player. Yeah. That's your boy, isn't it?

Yes, that's him. The pirate. Yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah. He was living in that place. He was living there. In England? No, but he was living there when he was here. In that building one place of the part of the river.
